posts.author: Sanguine
posts.title: With respect to lexi, the coder of VM.
posts.html:
I show  my respect while, I have a problem with the update. I understand it is to stop RDM, Door campers and known rules that are often broken.

We just had an increase of mods, and thats what hsould have been it.

This really hinders RP alot and this is why I will tell you.

The door system, as I stand by my point, was not needed at all. We have mods that should handle the door campers by moderating the server. We now thave to put up with a fee, especially for those not donating for double salary will have a huge problem with this.

Guns, the prices.

Okay, I am not really bothered by recoil anymore, but the prices are really to high. This is the most hinderable thing here. I think tranqs are going to be useless, because everyone will have to work in groups because its now 50k  a tranq, for an item that doesnt do damage. It shoulda been 30k a tranq or so.

I heard desert eagles are one hit kills: Who think that? They are not one hit kills.

Do not get me wrong, its overall nice features, new things such as furnature, but these are the main thing that will hinder light roleplay.

Please, do not give me the crap 'You will just have to learn to rp without a gun'.

The name is light rp, thank you.
